# Colorectal Cancer

A major cause of death among IBD patients, with increased risk in those with long-standing ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, or primary sclerosing cholangitis.

## Mentions

- Page 31: "Kolorektalkræft udgør fortsat en af de hyppigste dødsårsager blandt patienter med IBD" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[ulcerative-colitis|Ulcerative Colitis]] — increases-risk-of (incoming) — "Langvarig colitis ulcerosa eller Crohns sygdom øger risikoen for at udvikle kolorektalkræft" [^src1] (Page 31)
- [[crohns-disease|Crohn's Disease]] — increases-risk-of (incoming) — "Langvarig colitis ulcerosa eller Crohns sygdom øger risikoen for at udvikle kolorektalkræft" [^src1] (Page 31)
- [[primary-sclerosing-cholangitis|Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis]] — increases-risk-of (incoming) — "patienter med primær skleroserende kolangitis (PSC) også er i markant øget risiko for at udvikle kolorektalkræft" [^src1] (Page 31)
- [[koloskopi]] — enables-early-detection-of (incoming) — "Studier har vist at overvågningskoloskopier resulterer i tidlig diagnostik af kolorektalkræft og deraf bedre overlevelse" [^src1] (Page 31)

## Claims

- Colorectal cancer remains one of the most common causes of death among IBD patients ([[inflammatory-bowel-disease|Inflammatory Bowel Disease]], [[colorectal-cancer|Colorectal Cancer]])
- Surveillance colonoscopies result in early diagnosis of colorectal cancer and improved survival ([[koloskopi]], [[colorectal-cancer|Colorectal Cancer]])
